Drone services

Drone services for roofs, sites and projects.

Five services, one approach: agree what you need to understand, then capture exactly that. Free quotes across Cheshire.

Request a free quote Which service do I need?

What we do

From a roof question to usable aerial data.

Each service is scoped around the output you need. The exact scope is agreed before capture.

01

Roof inspections

Detailed aerial imagery of commercial and residential roofs, including the areas that are hard to reach safely.

Best for
Maintenance reviews, condition records, hard-to-reach areas.
You receive
Aerial photographs of the roof areas in your brief.
Roof inspections
02

RTK & 2D mapping

A current 2D orthomosaic map of your site, using RTK capture where the job needs positional accuracy.

Best for
Planning, progress review, CAD overlay, infrastructure.
You receive
A 2D orthomosaic map.
RTK & 2D mapping
03

3D modelling

Interactive, georeferenced 3D models for remote inspection and measurement, plus wider aerial surveys of larger sites.

Best for
Remote inspection, calculations, CAD/BIM-related work.
You receive
A georeferenced 3D model.
3D modelling
04

Aerial monitoring

Repeat capture from agreed viewpoints, so you can see how a site changes from one visit to the next.

Best for
Construction progress, stakeholder updates, transparency.
You receive
Regular aerial updates on progress.
Aerial monitoring
05

Photography & video

Aerial photography and video that shows a site, project or property clearly.

Best for
Project communication, property and site presentation.
You receive
Aerial photographs and video.
Photography & video
